snippet.title: Honkai: Star Rail Version 3.7 Trailer: "As Tomorrow Became Yesterday"
snippet.description:
Let the gods bear witness: The answer to the universe is not a blaze of fury that burns the stars to ash. People will step upon time's ripples, bridging a path between tomorrow and yesterday.
※ This video contains content in development. Please refer to the official launch version for final content.
